title: Law to require NYC fertility treatment information campaign
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to run a public education campaign, by December 1, 2027, explaining fertility treatment options and insurance and Medicaid coverage for them. The campaign would use ads on the internet, subways and LinkNYC kiosks, and materials would be distributed to hospitals, clinics and health care providers citywide. Starting December 1, 2028, the department would have to update and redistribute these materials to providers each year.
